# OS-FINALQA: the File rows that need a card, docs/qa/catalogue/file.md. The card is the scratch copy of the fixture e2e_pro (Projects/Kit with its four WAVs in samples/, generated by the
# target e2e_pro_fixture, never committed), found with --cards. The journey opens the Kit (its samples bind to the card's bank, so the pads have sound), then starts a NEW project with ALL
# (no folder, no title), which is what SAVE AS needs. One `snap` per row with a visible result; the goldens are keyed qa_file_card/qa_fil_NNN.

document
wait 20
card e2e_pro
wait 20
audio on
wait 20

# Open the Kit: its four sample instruments and their WAVs load from the card.
tap file
wait 300
assert state screen=FILE sel=Kit
tap f1
wait 1500
assert state screen=PATTERN msg=PROJECT_Kit_OPENED
assert model inst.1.name=SINE

# QA-FIL-118 (OS-AUDIT-26, E-GLOB-07): the pads play the current instrument on File. A pad held on the PROJECTS page sounds instrument 1 (the Kit's SINE: 441.18 Hz at the root pad 12)
# until it is let go, and nothing in the list or the project changes (the model's digest is the marked one after).
tap file
wait 200
assert state screen=FILE sel=Kit
mark model fil118
render fil118 400
pad 12 hold 300
wait 99
assert audio fil118 in=40-320 sound pitch=441.18+-4c clicks=0
assert audio fil118 in=320-400 silent
assert model digest=@fil118

# A NEW project with ALL: no folder and no title, which SAVE AS names.
tap f3
wait 50
tap f3
wait 500
assert state screen=PATTERN msg=NEW_PROJECT

# QA-FIL-113 (OS-SILENTMSG): SAVE AS with an empty name. The project has no title, so F5 opens the keyboard with the automatic Track 01, all of it selected; Delete (the keyboard's backspace)
# clears the selection, F1 on the empty name says TYPE A NAME in the keyboard's message line and stays open, and nothing is written.
tap file
wait 200
tap f5
wait 50
assert state overlay=TEXT_ENTRY
tap delete
tap f1
wait 50
assert state overlay=TEXT_ENTRY
snap qa_fil_113
assert file "Projects/Track 01" absent
tap f8
wait 50

# QA-FIL-061 (OS-NAMES): SAVE AS is prefilled from the title. Shift + F6 opens the keyboard over the project's (empty) title, the pads type "demo" and F1 keeps it (PROJECT NAMED); F5 then opens
# the SAVE AS keyboard with "demo" — the title reduced to the characters a folder name takes — selected. F8 leaves without saving.
press shift
tap f6
release shift
wait 50
assert state overlay=TEXT_ENTRY
pad 26
pad 14
pad 42
pad 20
tap f1
wait 50
assert state msg=PROJECT_NAMED
tap f5
wait 50
assert state overlay=TEXT_ENTRY
snap qa_fil_061
tap f8
wait 50
assert file "Projects/demo" absent
